en.headline: Alibaba reports 10 percent revenue rise and 92 percent jump in adjusted profit
en.dek: The e-commerce group said cloud and AI revenue surged, though adjusted profit missed estimates and free cash flow stayed negative amid heavy infrastructure spending.
body: Alibaba Group Holding reported on Thursday that revenue for the quarter ended 30 September rose 10 percent year on year to 271.5 billion yuan, beating market forecasts, while non-GAAP adjusted net profit jumped 92 percent to 19.9 billion yuan, short of consensus estimates.

The company said AI cloud and computing services revenue climbed 53 percent, with external customer revenue accelerating and AI-related product revenue posting a thirteenth consecutive quarter of triple-digit growth. Net income attributable to ordinary shareholders stood at 64.5 billion yuan.

Despite stronger operating cash flow, free cash flow remained negative at an outflow of 34.5 billion yuan, which management attributed mainly to increased investment in cloud infrastructure. In Hong Kong trading the shares closed down about 5.5 percent, extending a ten-session decline.

zh.headline: 阿里巴巴季度收入升10% 經調整純利大增92%
zh.dek: 電商集團指雲端及人工智能收入急升，惟經調整盈利低於預期，基建投資下自由現金流仍為流出。
body: 阿里巴巴集團周四公布截至9月30日止季度業績，收入按年上升10%至2715億元人民幣，高於市場預期；非公認會計準則經調整淨利潤大增92%至199億元人民幣，但低於分析師共識。
公司表示，人工智能雲及計算服務收入按年升53%，外部客戶收入加速增長，人工智能相關產品收入連續第13季錄得三位數按年增長。歸屬於普通股股東的淨利潤為645億元人民幣。
儘管經營活動現金流增加，自由現金流仍錄得344億元人民幣淨流出，管理層主要歸因於雲基建投資加大。港股收市跌約5.5%，連跌10個交易日。
